text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The crowd will never forget my run
today! They'll
never forget my
generation!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I will surpass Creek!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heavy panting...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(My flames raged to their extreme. I've
mastered
the blaze fierce and water
still!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki was unstoppable today! I
couldn't
take my eyes off of her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But just imagine if Oguri Cap was here...
She
totally would have won!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's injured. But yeah, who knows
what
would have happened.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Still not good enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You were quite the force out there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It was like the air around you kept
getting hotter
and hotter. I was
beginning to worry I might get
burned.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for you. I did all I could
to avoid
being overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I feel like I've gotten a little
closer to
knowing the real you. I like it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Think we'll get even closer next time? I
can hardly
wait to find out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...It's so hard to read her sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Did you see? I perfectly wielded my
fierce blaze
today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have an obsession, everything
has
become clear. I can focus myself
entirely on the
path ahead of me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My heart is blazing brighter than it ever
has. I'm
certain it was my desire to beat
Creek that drove
me forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And while the flames blazed, I didn't
allow them
to run wild! They were under
perfect control!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All the same... It seems I've yet to leave
a strong
enough impression on the
audience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't run well enough to burn away
the
impression Oguri has left in their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Even though Oguri Cap
didn't run
today, I heard her name
mentioned over and over
again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It seems there's nothing to do but defeat
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to prove our worth, there's
no
avoiding it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've found my obsession and
perfected
my control over it, I'm sure I
can win against her!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want to face Oguri in my next
race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I heard that she is
making a
speedy recovery and is eyeing
her next race...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Then I'd like to run in the Yasuda Kinen
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our goal is decided. Yaeno
Muteki will
take on Oguri Cap in a
pivotal race at the Yasuda
Kinen!
